name: Chroma icon
description: Rainbow-cycles your icon colors, glow, trails and fire. Pick exactly what is affected in the settings.

show-rainbow-palette.name: Rainbow palette color on
show-rainbow-palette.description: Adds a Rainbow swatch to the icon kit color grid. Anyone with this mod whose color is the Rainbow swatch is drawn as a moving rainbow. Turn off to disable everything.

rainbow-id.name: Rainbow palette slot number
rainbow-id.description: A NEW slot number that is not one of the normal palette colors. Everyone with the mod must use the same number. Pick a normal color again before removing the mod.

speed.name: Speed (cycles per second)
speed.description: How fast the rainbow cycles. 0.3 is about one full loop every 3 seconds.

color-1-offset.name: Color 1 hue offset
color-1-offset.description: 0 = Color 1 matches Color 2. 0.5 = opposite side of the rainbow.

title-effects.name: Effects (when my icon uses the rainbow)

ship-fire.name: Ship and UFO fire / click particles
